enacted_as: California Constitution Article I, Section 7 (added by Proposition 7, November 5, 1974)
source_description: Text reconstructed from current leginfo text minus the 1979 Prop. 1 busing amendment language. The pre-1979 Section 7(a) contained only the first sentence: 'A person may not be deprived of life, liberty, or property without due process of law or denied equal protection of the laws.' All busing-related language in current 7(a) was added by Prop. 1 in 1979. Section 7(b) has never been amended since 1974.
reconstruction_method: Subtraction: current leginfo text minus known 1979 Prop. 1 additions. The 1979 amendment added all language after the first sentence of subdivision (a). This reconstruction is consistent with the leginfo annotation: 'Subdivision (a) amended Nov. 6, 1979, by Prop. 1. Res.Ch. 18, 1979. Other Source: Entire Sec. 7 was added Nov. 5, 1974, by Prop. 7; Res.Ch. 90, 1974.'
primary_source_outstanding: The original Proposition 7 ballot pamphlet (1974) would contain the complete text as submitted to voters. Available from California State Archives or Hastings Law Library ballot proposition archive.
